connector.name: Nan Forget
connector.registryDescription: AI that remembers. Local-first cross-session, cross-project long-term memory for coding tools.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package nan-forget. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nanmesh account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI API key for embeddings. If not set, falls back to local Ollama.

env.name: NAN_FORGET_PROJECT_ROOT
env.description: Project root used for local memory file sync and cleanup
